name: Processor D
note: 6-qubit linear-chain design targeting reduced CX count and routing overhead. Same synthetic noise model as A and B for fair comparison. Chosen to address the CX-count bottleneck observed on Processor A (7.0 mean CX vs 4.0 on Processor B). The linear chain reduces SWAP overhead at the cost of some connectivity, providing a baseline for measuring the trade-off between connectivity and noise resilience.
